body.title: Convert actions and change gh_pr_diff and gh_run_view
body.summary: Convert actions.ts; move gh_pr_diff and gh_run_view to the cut-is-answer capture and sc3 conversion with key-value cross-check, add truncated to gh_run_view, and make a failed log command a real failure; register the converted tools.
acceptanceChecks: a capture cut at the cap is a success with truncated true and valid text across a multibyte character
a failed gh run view log command fails the call with stderr in error
a failed cross-check gives conversion-failed with the raw text in failure.original

tests.name: gh-capture.test.ts: gh_pr_diff and gh_run_view cut at the cap are successes with truncated true and valid text
gh-convert-text.test.ts: gh_pr_diff and gh_run_view conversions cross-check against the raw text and a failed cross-check gives conversion-failed with the raw text in failure.original
gh-failures.test.ts: a failed gh run view log command fails the call with stderr in error
